```cpp
matrix4x4f& matrix4x4f::operator+=(const matrix4x4f& data
) noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_DXM
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_0 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[0][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_1 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[1][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_2 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[2][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_3 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[3][0]
		)
	);

	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_argument_0 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&data.m_base.m[0][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_argument_1 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&data.m_base.m[1][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_argument_2 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&data.m_base.m[2][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_argument_3 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&data.m_base.m[3][0]
		)
	);

	row_original_0 =
		DirectX::XMVectorAdd(row_original_0, row_argument_0);
	row_original_1 =
		DirectX::XMVectorAdd(row_original_1, row_argument_1);
	row_original_2 =
		DirectX::XMVectorAdd(row_original_2, row_argument_2);
	row_original_3 =
		DirectX::XMVectorAdd(row_original_3, row_argument_3);

	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[0][0]
		),
		row_original_0
	);
	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[1][0]
		),
		row_original_1
	);
	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[2][0]
		),
		row_original_2
	);
	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[3][0]
		),
		row_original_3
	);
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_GLM)
	this->m_base += data.m_base;
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_OWN)
	this->m_base += data.m_base;
#else
	#error unknown math library
#endif
	return *this;
}

matrix4x4f& matrix4x4f::operator-=(const matrix4x4f& data
) noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_DXM
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_0 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[0][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_1 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[1][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_2 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[2][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_3 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[3][0]
		)
	);

	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_argument_0 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&data.m_base.m[0][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_argument_1 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&data.m_base.m[1][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_argument_2 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&data.m_base.m[2][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_argument_3 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&data.m_base.m[3][0]
		)
	);

	row_original_0 = DirectX::XMVectorSubtract(
		row_original_0, row_argument_0
	);
	row_original_1 = DirectX::XMVectorSubtract(
		row_original_1, row_argument_1
	);
	row_original_2 = DirectX::XMVectorSubtract(
		row_original_2, row_argument_2
	);
	row_original_3 = DirectX::XMVectorSubtract(
		row_original_3, row_argument_3
	);

	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[0][0]
		),
		row_original_0
	);
	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[1][0]
		),
		row_original_1
	);
	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[2][0]
		),
		row_original_2
	);
	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[3][0]
		),
		row_original_3
	);
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_GLM)
	this->m_base -= data.m_base;
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_OWN)
	this->m_base -= data.m_base;
#else
	#error unknown math library
#endif
	return *this;
}

matrix4x4f& matrix4x4f::operator*=(const matrix4x4f& data
) noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_DXM
	// storage is the transpose of the logical matrix, so the
	// operands are swapped: (L*R)^T == R^T * L^T
	DirectX::XMMATRIX m1 = data;
	DirectX::XMMATRIX m2 = *this;

	auto result = DirectX::XMMatrixMultiply(m1, m2);

	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4x4(&this->m_base, result);
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_GLM)
	this->m_base *= data.m_base;
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_OWN)
	this->m_base *= data.m_base;
#else
	#error unknown math library
#endif

	return *this;
}

matrix4x4f& matrix4x4f::operator*=(float value) noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_DXM
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_0 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[0][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_1 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[1][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_2 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[2][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_3 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[3][0]
		)
	);

	row_original_0 =
		DirectX::XMVectorScale(row_original_0, value);
	row_original_1 =
		DirectX::XMVectorScale(row_original_1, value);
	row_original_2 =
		DirectX::XMVectorScale(row_original_2, value);
	row_original_3 =
		DirectX::XMVectorScale(row_original_3, value);

	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[0][0]
		),
		row_original_0
	);
	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[1][0]
		),
		row_original_1
	);
	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[2][0]
		),
		row_original_2
	);
	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[3][0]
		),
		row_original_3
	);
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_GLM)
	this->m_base *= value;
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_OWN)
	this->m_base *= value;
#else
	#error unknown math library
#endif
	return *this;
}

matrix4x4f& matrix4x4f::operator/=(float value) noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_DXM
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_0 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[0][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_1 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(

			&this->m_base.m[1][0]

	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_2 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(

		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_3 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[3][0]
		)
	);

	float factor = 1.f / value;

	row_original_0 =
		DirectX::XMVectorScale(row_original_0, factor);
	row_original_1 =
		DirectX::XMVectorScale(row_original_1, factor);
	row_original_2 =
		DirectX::XMVectorScale(row_original_2, factor);
	row_original_3 =
		DirectX::XMVectorScale(row_original_3, factor);

	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[0][0]
		),
		row_original_0
	);
	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[1][0]
		),
		row_original_1
	);
	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[2][0]
		),
		row_original_2
	);
	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[3][0]
		),
		row_original_3
	);
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_GLM)
	this->m_base /= value;
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_OWN)
	this->m_base /= value;
#else
	#error unknown math library
#endif

	return *this;

matrix4x4f matrix4x4f::operator-() const noexcept
{
	matrix4x4f result;
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_DXM
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_0 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[0][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_1 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[1][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_2 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[2][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_3 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[3][0]
		)
	);

	row_original_0 = DirectX::XMVectorNegate(row_original_0);
	row_original_1 = DirectX::XMVectorNegate(row_original_1);
	row_original_2 = DirectX::XMVectorNegate(row_original_2);
	row_original_3 = DirectX::XMVectorNegate(row_original_3);

	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&result.m_base.m[0][0]
		),
		row_original_0
	);

	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&result.m_base.m[1][0]
		),
		row_original_1
	);

	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&result.m_base.m[2][0]
		),
		row_original_2
	);

	DirectX::XMStoreFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&result.m_base.m[3][0]
		),
		row_original_3
	);
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_GLM)
	result = -this->m_base;
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_OWN)
	result = -this->m_base;
#else
	#error unknown math library
#endif
	return result;
}

bool matrix4x4f::operator==(const matrix4x4f& data
) const noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_DXM
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_0 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[0][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_1 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[1][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_2 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[2][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_original_3 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&this->m_base.m[3][0]
		)
	);

	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_argument_0 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&data.m_base.m[0][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_argument_1 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&data.m_base.m[1][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_argument_2 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&data.m_base.m[2][0]
		)
	);
	DirectX::XMVECTOR row_argument_3 = DirectX::XMLoadFloat4(
		reinterpret_cast<const DirectX::XMFLOAT4*>(
			&data.m_base.m[3][0]
		)
	);

	bool is_equal_0 =
		DirectX::XMVector4Equal(row_original_0, row_argument_0);
	bool is_equal_1 =
		DirectX::XMVector4Equal(row_original_1, row_argument_1);
	bool is_equal_2 =
		DirectX::XMVector4Equal(row_original_2, row_argument_2);
	bool is_equal_3 =
		DirectX::XMVector4Equal(row_original_3, row_argument_3);

	return (
		is_equal_0 && is_equal_1 && is_equal_2 && is_equal_3
	);
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_GLM)
	return this->m_base == data.m_base;
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_OWN)
	return this->m_base == data.m_base;
#else
	#error unknown math library
#endif
}
```

```cpp
#include "../include/kotek_std_math_matrixnf_view.h"

matrixnf_view_t::matrixnf_view_t(
	float* p_values, math_id_t column_count, math_id_t row_count
) :
	_m_default(0.0f), m_column_count(column_count),
	m_row_count(row_count), m_p_values(p_values)
{
	KOTEK_ASSERT(column_count > 0, "valid data");
	KOTEK_ASSERT(row_count > 0, "valid data");
	KOTEK_ASSERT(p_values, "valid data");
}

matrixnf_view_t&
matrixnf_view_t::operator+=(const vectornf_view_t& view
) noexcept
{
	if (view.get_column_count() > 4 || view.get_row_count() > 4)
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			false,
			"not yet impl, todo: provide vectornf and matrixnf "
			"impls"
		);
	}
	else
	{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_BROADCASTING
		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			this->get_row_count() >= view.get_row_count(),
			"out-of-range"
		);
		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			this->get_column_count() >= view.get_column_count(),
			"out-of-range"
		);

		if (this->get_row_count() >= view.get_row_count())
		{
			if (this->get_column_count() >=
			    view.get_row_count())
			{
				for (math_id_t i = 0; i < view.get_row_count();
				     ++i)
				{
					this->c(i) += view;
				}
			}
		}
#else
		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			this->get_row_count() == view.get_row_count(),
			"broadcasting is not enabled thus a such operation "
			"where mxn + 1xk is not defined operation in "
			"linear algebra!"
		);

		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			this->get_column_count() == view.get_row_count(),
			"broadcasting is not enabled thus a such operation "
			"where mxn + 1xk is not defined operation in "
			"linear algebra!"
		);

		if (this->get_row_count() == view.get_row_count())
		{
			for (math_id_t i = 0; i < view.get_row_count(); ++i)
			{
				this->c(i) += view;
			}
		}
#endif
	}

	return *this;
}

matrixnf_view_t&
matrixnf_view_t::operator+=(const matrixnf_view_t& view
) noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_BROADCASTING
	#error todo: impl
#else
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_column_count() == view.get_column_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_row_count() == view.get_row_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	switch (this->get_column_count())
	{
	case 2:
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			this->get_row_count() == 2, "expected quad matrix"
		);

		matrix2x2f left(*this);
		matrix2x2f right(view);

		left += right;

		this->c(0).x() = left.e(0, 0);
		this->c(0).y() = left.e(0, 1);

		this->c(1).x() = left.e(1, 0);
		this->c(1).y() = left.e(1, 1);

		break;
	}
	case 3:
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			this->get_row_count() == 3, "expected quad matrix"
		);

		matrix3x3f left(*this);
		matrix3x3f right(view);

		left += right;

		this->c(0).x() = left.e(0, 0);
		this->c(0).y() = left.e(0, 1);
		this->c(0).z() = left.e(0, 2);

		this->c(1).x() = left.e(1, 0);
		this->c(1).y() = left.e(1, 1);
		this->c(1).z() = left.e(1, 2);

		this->c(2).x() = left.e(2, 0);
		this->c(2).y() = left.e(2, 1);
		this->c(2).z() = left.e(2, 2);

		break;
	}
	case 4:
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			this->get_row_count() == 4, "expected quad matrix"
		);

		matrix4x4f left(*this);
		matrix4x4f right(view);

		left += right;

		this->c(0).x() = left.e(0, 0);
		this->c(0).y() = left.e(0, 1);
		this->c(0).z() = left.e(0, 2);
		this->c(0).w() = left.e(0, 3);

		this->c(1).x() = left.e(1, 0);
		this->c(1).y() = left.e(1, 1);
		this->c(1).z() = left.e(1, 2);
		this->c(2).w() = left.e(1, 3);

		this->c(2).x() = left.e(2, 0);
		this->c(2).y() = left.e(2, 1);
		this->c(2).z() = left.e(2, 2);
		this->c(2).w() = left.e(2, 3);

		this->c(3).x() = left.e(3, 0);
		this->c(3).y() = left.e(3, 1);
		this->c(3).z() = left.e(3, 2);
		this->c(3).w() = left.e(3, 3);

		break;
	}
	default:
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(false, "unhanled case");
		break;
	}
	}
#endif

	return *this;
}

matrixnf_view_t& matrixnf_view_t::operator+=(const vector1f& vec
) noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_BROADCASTING
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_column_count() >= vec.get_column_count(),
		"out-of-range"
	);

	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_row_count() >= vec.get_row_count(),
		"out of range"
	);

	if (this->get_row_count() >= vec.get_row_count())
	{
		for (math_id_t i = 0; i < vec.get_row_count(); ++i)
		{
			this->c(i) += vec;
		}
	}
#else

		this->get_column_count() == vec.get_row_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting!"
	);

	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_row_count() == vec.get_row_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	if (this->get_row_count() == vec.get_row_count() &&
	    this->get_column_count() == vec.get_row_count())
	{
		for (math_id_t i = 0; i < vec.get_row_count(); ++i)

			this->c(i) += vec;
		}

#endif

matrixnf_view_t&
matrixnf_view_t::operator+=(const matrix2x2f& mat) noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_BROADCASTING
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_column_count() >= mat.get_column_count(),
		"out-of-range"
	);
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_row_count() >= mat.get_row_count(),
		"out-of-range"
	);

	if (this->get_column_count() >= mat.get_column_count())
	{
		if (this->get_row_count() >= mat.get_row_count())
		{
			matrix2x2f casted(*this);
			casted += mat;
			this->c(0).x() = casted[0][0];
			this->c(0).y() = casted[0][1];
			this->c(1).x() = casted[1][0];
			this->c(1).y() = casted[1][1];
		}
	}
#else
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_column_count() == mat.get_column_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_row_count() == mat.get_row_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	if (this->get_row_count() == mat.get_row_count() &&
	    this->get_column_count() == mat.get_column_count())
	{
		matrix2x2f casted(*this);
		casted += mat;

		this->c(0).x() = casted[0][0];
		this->c(0).y() = casted[0][1];

		this->c(1).x() = casted[1][0];
		this->c(1).y() = casted[1][1];
	}
#endif

	return *this;
}

matrixnf_view_t&
matrixnf_view_t::operator-=(const vectornf_view_t& view
) noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_BROADCASTING
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_column_count() >= view.get_column_count(),
		"out-of-range"
	);

	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_row_count() >= view.get_row_count(),
		"out of range"
	);

	if (this->get_row_count() >= view.get_row_count())
	{
		for (math_id_t i = 0; i < view.get_row_count(); ++i)
		{
			this->c(i) -= view;
		}
	}
#else
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_column_count() == view.get_row_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting!"
	);

	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_row_count() == view.get_row_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	if (this->get_row_count() == view.get_row_count() &&
	    this->get_column_count() == view.get_row_count())
	{
		for (math_id_t i = 0; i < view.get_row_count(); ++i)
		{
			this->c(i) -= view;
		}
	}

#endif

	return *this;
}

matrixnf_view_t&
matrixnf_view_t::operator-=(const matrixnf_view_t& view
) noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_BROADCASTING
	#error todo: impl
#else
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_column_count() == view.get_column_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_row_count() == view.get_row_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	switch (this->get_column_count())
	{
	case 2:
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			this->get_row_count() == 2, "expected quad matrix"
		);

		matrix2x2f left(*this);
		matrix2x2f right(view);

		left -= right;

		this->c(0).x() = left.e(0, 0);
		this->c(0).y() = left.e(0, 1);

		this->c(1).x() = left.e(1, 0);
		this->c(1).y() = left.e(1, 1);

		break;
	}
	case 3:
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			this->get_row_count() == 3, "expected quad matrix"
		);

		matrix3x3f left(*this);
		matrix3x3f right(view);

		left -= right;

		this->c(0).x() = left.e(0, 0);
		this->c(0).y() = left.e(0, 1);
		this->c(0).z() = left.e(0, 2);

		this->c(1).x() = left.e(1, 0);
		this->c(1).y() = left.e(1, 1);
		this->c(1).z() = left.e(1, 2);

		this->c(2).x() = left.e(2, 0);
		this->c(2).y() = left.e(2, 1);
		this->c(2).z() = left.e(2, 2);

		break;
	}
	case 4:
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			this->get_row_count() == 4, "expected quad matrix"
		);

		matrix4x4f left(*this);
		matrix4x4f right(view);

		left -= right;

		this->c(0).x() = left.e(0, 0);
		this->c(0).y() = left.e(0, 1);
		this->c(0).z() = left.e(0, 2);
		this->c(0).w() = left.e(0, 3);

		this->c(1).x() = left.e(1, 0);
		this->c(1).y() = left.e(1, 1);
		this->c(1).z() = left.e(1, 2);
		this->c(2).w() = left.e(1, 3);

		this->c(2).x() = left.e(2, 0);
		this->c(2).y() = left.e(2, 1);
		this->c(2).z() = left.e(2, 2);
		this->c(2).w() = left.e(2, 3);

		this->c(3).x() = left.e(3, 0);
		this->c(3).y() = left.e(3, 1);
		this->c(3).z() = left.e(3, 2);
		this->c(3).w() = left.e(3, 3);

		break;
	}
	default:
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(false, "unhanled case");
		break;
	}
	}
#endif

	return *this;
}

matrixnf_view_t& matrixnf_view_t::operator-=(const vector1f& vec
) noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_BROADCASTING
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_column_count() >= vec.get_column_count(),
		"out-of-range"
	);

	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_row_count() >= vec.get_row_count(),
		"out of range"
	);

	if (this->get_row_count() >= vec.get_row_count())
	{
		for (math_id_t i = 0; i < vec.get_row_count(); ++i)
		{
			this->c(i) -= vec;
		}
	}
#else
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_column_count() == vec.get_row_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting!"
	);

	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_row_count() == vec.get_row_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	if (this->get_row_count() == vec.get_row_count() &&
	    this->get_column_count() == vec.get_row_count())
	{
		for (math_id_t i = 0; i < vec.get_row_count(); ++i)
		{
			this->c(i) -= vec;
		}
	}

#endif

	return *this;
}

matrixnf_view_t&
matrixnf_view_t::operator-=(const matrix2x2f& mat) noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_BROADCASTING
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_column_count() >= mat.get_column_count(),
		"out-of-range"
	);
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_row_count() >= mat.get_row_count(),
		"out-of-range"
	);

	if (this->get_column_count() >= mat.get_column_count())
	{
		if (this->get_row_count() >= mat.get_row_count())
		{
			matrix2x2f casted(*this);
			casted += mat;
			this->c(0).x() = casted[0][0];
			this->c(0).y() = casted[0][1];
			this->c(1).x() = casted[1][0];
			this->c(1).y() = casted[1][1];
		}
	}
#else
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_column_count() == mat.get_column_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_row_count() == mat.get_row_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	if (this->get_row_count() == mat.get_row_count() &&
	    this->get_column_count() == mat.get_column_count())
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			this->get_row_count() == 2,
			"expected quad matrix otherwise provide "
			"implementation and dimension of a such matrix!"
		);

		matrix2x2f casted(*this);
		casted -= mat;

		this->c(0).x() = casted[0][0];
		this->c(0).y() = casted[0][1];

		this->c(1).x() = casted[1][0];
		this->c(1).y() = casted[1][1];
	}
#endif

	return *this;
}

	if (this->get_column_count() >= mat.get_column_count())

			this->c(0).x() = casted[0][0];
			this->c(0).y() = casted[0][1];
			this->c(1).x() = casted[1][0];
			this->c(1).y() = casted[1][1];
		}
	}
#else
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_column_count() == mat.get_column_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_row_count() == mat.get_row_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	if (this->get_row_count() == mat.get_row_count() &&
	    this->get_column_count() == mat.get_column_count())
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			this->get_row_count() == 3,
			"expected quad matrix otherwise provide "
			"implementation and dimension of a such matrix!"
		);

		matrix3x3f casted(*this);
		casted -= mat;

		this->c(0).x() = casted[0][0];
		this->c(0).y() = casted[0][1];
		this->c(0).z() = casted[0][2];

		this->c(1).x() = casted[1][0];
		this->c(1).y() = casted[1][1];
		this->c(1).z() = casted[1][2];

		this->c(2).x() = casted[2][0];
		this->c(2).y() = casted[2][1];
		this->c(2).z() = casted[2][2];
	}
#endif

	return *this;
}

matrixnf_view_t&
matrixnf_view_t::operator-=(const matrix4x4f& mat) noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_BROADCASTING
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_column_count() >= mat.get_column_count(),
		"out-of-range"
	);
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_row_count() >= mat.get_row_count(),
		"out-of-range"
	);

	if (this->get_column_count() >= mat.get_column_count())
	{
		if (this->get_row_count() >= mat.get_row_count())
		{
			matrix2x2f casted(*this);
			casted += mat;
			this->c(0).x() = casted[0][0];
			this->c(0).y() = casted[0][1];
			this->c(1).x() = casted[1][0];
			this->c(1).y() = casted[1][1];
		}
	}
#else
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_column_count() == mat.get_column_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_row_count() == mat.get_row_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	if (this->get_row_count() == mat.get_row_count() &&
	    this->get_column_count() == mat.get_column_count())
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			this->get_row_count() == 4,
			"expected quad matrix otherwise provide "
			"implementation and dimension of a such matrix!"
		);

		matrix4x4f casted(*this);
		casted -= mat;

		this->c(0).x() = casted[0][0];
		this->c(0).y() = casted[0][1];
		this->c(0).z() = casted[0][2];
		this->c(0).w() = casted[0][3];

		this->c(1).x() = casted[1][0];
		this->c(1).y() = casted[1][1];
		this->c(1).z() = casted[1][2];
		this->c(1).w() = casted[1][3];

		this->c(2).x() = casted[2][0];
		this->c(2).y() = casted[2][1];
		this->c(2).z() = casted[2][2];
		this->c(2).w() = casted[2][3];

		this->c(3).x() = casted[3][0];
		this->c(3).y() = casted[3][1];
		this->c(3).z() = casted[3][2];
		this->c(3).w() = casted[3][3];
	}
#endif

	return *this;
}

matrixnf_view_t&
matrixnf_view_t::operator*=(const vectornf_view_t& view
) noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_BROADCASTING
	#error todo: impl
#else
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_column_count() == view.get_row_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	// todo: think about it because our matrix that was a view
	// now becomes a vector due to matrix x vector
	// multiplication
	switch (this->get_column_count())
	{
	case 2:
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			this->get_row_count() == 2,
			"expected quad matrix otherwise provide "
			"implementation and dimension of a such matrix!"
		);

		matrix2x2f casted(*this);

		const vector2f& result = casted * view;

		this->m_column_count = 1;
		this->m_row_count = 2;

		this->e(0, 0) = result.x();
		this->e(0, 1) = result.y();

		break;
	}
	case 3:
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			this->get_row_count() == 3,
			"expected quad matrix otherwise provide "
			"implementation and dimension of a such matrix!"
		);

		matrix3x3f casted(*this);

		const vector3f& result = casted * view;

		this->m_column_count = 1;
		this->m_row_count = 3;

		this->e(0, 0) = result.x();
		this->e(0, 1) = result.y();
		this->e(0, 2) = result.z();

		break;
	}
	case 4:
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(
			this->get_row_count() == 4,
			"expected quad matrix otherwise provide "
			"implementation and dimension of a such matrix!"
		);

		matrix4x4f casted(*this);

		const vector4f& result = casted * view;

		this->m_column_count = 1;
		this->m_row_count = 4;

		this->e(0, 0) = result.x();
		this->e(0, 1) = result.y();
		this->e(0, 2) = result.z();
		this->e(0, 3) = result.w();

		break;
	}
	default:
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(false, "unhandled situation");
		break;
	}
	}
#endif

	return *this;
}

matrixnf_view_t&
matrixnf_view_t::operator*=(const matrixnf_view_t& view
) noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_BROADCASTING
	#error todo: is it even can be broadcasted??
#else
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_row_count() == view.get_column_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rules"
	);

	if (this->get_row_count() == view.get_column_count())
	{
		switch (this->get_row_count())
		{
		case 2:
		{
			KOTEK_ASSERT(
				this->get_column_count() == 2,
				"expected quad matrix otherwise provide impl "
				"for a such matrix dimension!"
			);

			matrix2x2f left(*this);
			matrix2x2f right(view);

			left *= right;

			this->e(0, 0) = left.e(0, 0);
			this->e(0, 1) = left.e(0, 1);
			this->e(1, 0) = left.e(1, 0);
			this->e(1, 1) = left.e(1, 1);

			break;
		}
		case 3:
		{
			KOTEK_ASSERT(
				this->get_column_count() == 3,
				"expected quad matrix otherwise provide impl "
				"for a such matrix dimension!"
			);

			matrix3x3f left(*this);
			matrix3x3f right(view);

			left *= right;

			this->e(0, 0) = left.e(0, 0);
			this->e(0, 1) = left.e(0, 1);
			this->e(0, 2) = left.e(0, 2);

			this->e(1, 0) = left.e(1, 0);
			this->e(1, 1) = left.e(1, 1);
			this->e(1, 2) = left.e(1, 2);

			this->e(2, 0) = left.e(2, 0);
			this->e(2, 1) = left.e(2, 1);
			this->e(2, 2) = left.e(2, 2);

			break;
		}
		case 4:
		{
			KOTEK_ASSERT(
				this->get_column_count() == 4,
				"expected quad matrix otherwise provide impl "
				"for a such matrix dimension!"
			);

			matrix4x4f left(*this);
			matrix4x4f right(view);

			left *= right;

			this->e(0, 0) = left.e(0, 0);
			this->e(0, 1) = left.e(0, 1);
			this->e(0, 2) = left.e(0, 2);
			this->e(0, 3) = left.e(0, 3);

			this->e(1, 0) = left.e(1, 0);
			this->e(1, 1) = left.e(1, 1);
			this->e(1, 2) = left.e(1, 2);
			this->e(1, 3) = left.e(1, 3);

			this->e(2, 0) = left.e(2, 0);
			this->e(2, 1) = left.e(2, 1);
			this->e(2, 2) = left.e(2, 2);
			this->e(2, 3) = left.e(2, 3);

			break;
		}
		default:
		{
			KOTEK_ASSERT(false, "unhandled situation");
			break;
		}
		}
	}
#endif

	return *this;
}

matrixnf_view_t& matrixnf_view_t::operator*=(const vector1f& vec
) noexcept
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_BROADCASTING
	#error todo: impl
#else
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->get_column_count() == vec.get_row_count(),
		"strict linear algebra rule, otherwise enable "
		"broadcasting"
	);

	switch (this->get_column_count())
	{
	case 1:
	{
		this->e(0, 0) *= vec.x();

		this->m_row_count = vec.get_row_count();
		this->m_column_count = 1;

		break;
	}
	default:
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(false, "expected mat1x1");
		break;
	}
	}
#endif

	return *this;
}

vectornf_view_t matrixnf_view_t::c(math_id_t column_id) noexcept
{
	vectornf_view_t result;

	KOTEK_ASSERT(this->m_p_values, "valid data");
	KOTEK_ASSERT(this->m_column_count > 0, "valid data");
	KOTEK_ASSERT(this->m_row_count > 0, "valid data");

	if (this->m_column_count > 0 && this->m_row_count > 0)
	{
		if (column_id > this->m_column_count)
			column_id = this->m_column_count;

		math_id_t id = column_id * this->m_row_count;

		result = vectornf_view_t(
			&this->m_p_values[id], this->m_row_count
		);
	}

	return result;
}

vectornf_const_view_t matrixnf_view_t::c(math_id_t column_id
) const noexcept
{
	vectornf_const_view_t result;

	KOTEK_ASSERT(this->m_p_values, "valid data");
	KOTEK_ASSERT(this->m_column_count > 0, "valid data");
	KOTEK_ASSERT(this->m_row_count > 0, "valid data");

	if (this->m_column_count > 0 && this->m_row_count > 0)
	{
		if (column_id > this->m_column_count)
			column_id = this->m_column_count;

		math_id_t id = column_id * this->m_row_count;

		result = vectornf_const_view_t(
			&this->m_p_values[id], this->m_row_count
		);
	}

	return result;
}

void matrixnf_view_t::set(
	float* p_data, math_id_t element_count
) noexcept
{
	KOTEK_ASSERT(p_data, "valid data");
	KOTEK_ASSERT(element_count > 0, "valid data");

	if (p_data && element_count > 0)
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(this->m_p_values, "valid data");
		KOTEK_ASSERT(this->m_column_count > 0, "valid data");
		KOTEK_ASSERT(this->m_row_count > 0, "valid data");

		if (this->m_p_values && this->m_column_count > 0 &&
		    this->m_row_count > 0)
		{
		}
	}
}

void matrixnf_view_t::set(
	float* p_data, math_id_t column_id, math_id_t row_id
) noexcept
{
	KOTEK_ASSERT(p_data, "valid data");
	KOTEK_ASSERT(column_id > 0, "valid data");
	KOTEK_ASSERT(row_id > 0, "valid data");

	if (p_data && column_id > 0 && row_id > 0)
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(this->m_p_values, "valid data");
		KOTEK_ASSERT(this->m_column_count > 0, "valid data");
		KOTEK_ASSERT(this->m_row_count > 0, "valid data");

		if (this->m_p_values && this->m_column_count > 0 &&
		    this->m_row_count > 0)
		{
		}
	}

		}

vectornf_const_view_t
matrixnf_const_view_t::c(math_id_t column_id) const noexcept
{
	KOTEK_ASSERT(this->m_p_values, "not initialized");
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		column_id > this->m_column_count, "out-of-range"
	);

	if (column_id > this->get_column_count())
		column_id = this->get_column_count();

	return vectornf_const_view_t(
		&this->m_p_values[column_id * this->get_row_count()],
		this->get_row_count()
	);
}
```

```cpp
		DirectX::XMVectorScale(casted_original, value);

	DirectX::XMStoreFloat(&this->m_base, result);
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_GLM)
	this->m_base *= value;
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_OWN)
	this->m_base *= value;
#endif
	return *this;
}

	auto casted_original = DirectX::XMLoadFloat(&this->m_base);
	auto casted_argument = DirectX::XMLoadFloat(&data.m_base);
	auto result = DirectX::XMVectorMultiply(
		casted_original, casted_argument
	);

	DirectX::XMStoreFloat(&this->m_base, result);

	this->m_base *= data.m_base;

vector1f& vector1f::operator/=(float value)
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_DXM
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		value != 0.0f, "you can't divide if you have zero!!!"
	);

	auto casted_original = DirectX::XMLoadFloat(&this->m_base);
	auto result =
		DirectX::XMVectorScale(casted_original, 1.f / value);
	DirectX::XMStoreFloat(&this->m_base, result);
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_GLM)
	this->m_base /= value;
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_OWN)
	this->m_base /= value;
#endif
	return *this;
}

		index = 0;

	float const* p_array =
		reinterpret_cast<float const*>(&this->m_base);

	return p_array[index];
#elif defined(KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_GLM)
	return this->m_base[index];

	return this->m_base;

	#error unknown math library
#endif
}
```

```cpp
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
#else
	if (p_arr2)
	{
		KOTEK_ASSERT(size == 2, "wrong dimension");

		if (size == 2)
		{
			this->m_base.x = p_arr2[0];
			this->m_base.y = p_arr2[1];
		}
		else
		{
			this->m_base.x = 0.0f;
			this->m_base.y = 0.0f;
		}
	}
	else

		this->m_base.y = 0.0f;
	}
#endif

vector2f::vector2f(const vectornf_view_t& view)
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	#error todo: impl
#else

	KOTEK_ASSERT(view.data(), "not initialized or corrupted");
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		view.get_row_count() == get_row_count(),
		"wrong dimension"
	);

	if (view.data())
	{
		if (view.get_row_count() == get_row_count())
		{
			this->m_base.x = view.x();
			this->m_base.y = view.y();
		}
	}
#endif
}
```

```cpp
			this->m_base.x = p_arr3[0];
```

```cpp
vector4f::vector4f(const vectornf_view_t& view)
{
#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	#error todo: impl
#else

	KOTEK_ASSERT(view.data(), "not initialized or corrupted");
	KOTEK_ASSERT(view.get_row_count() == get_row_count(), "wrong dimension");

	if (view.data())
	{
		if (view.get_row_count() == get_row_count())
		{
			this->m_base.x = view.x();
			this->m_base.y = view.y();
			this->m_base.z = view.z();
			this->m_base.w = view.w();
		}
	}
#endif
}
```

```cpp
void vectornf_view_t::set(
	float* p_data, math_id_t element_count
) noexcept
{
	KOTEK_ASSERT(p_data, "data must be valid");
	KOTEK_ASSERT(element_count > 0, "can't be null");
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->m_row_count <= element_count, "overwrite memory!"
	);

	if (p_data && this->m_row_count <= element_count)
	{
		std::memcpy(
			this->m_p_values,
			p_data,
			sizeof(float) * element_count
		);
	}
}

void vectornf_view_t::set(const vectornf_view_t& view) noexcept
{
	KOTEK_ASSERT(view.data(), "data must be valid");
	KOTEK_ASSERT(view.get_row_count() > 0, "can't be null");
	KOTEK_ASSERT(
		this->m_row_count <= view.get_row_count(),
		"overwrite memory!"
	);

	if (view.data() &&
	    this->m_row_count <= view.get_row_count())
	{
		std::memcpy(
			this->m_p_values,
			view.data(),
			sizeof(float) * view.get_row_count()
		);
	}
}
```

```cpp
TEST(Math, vector2f_testing_binary_plus_operator_both_vectors)
{
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f test1(50.5f, 2.5f);
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f test2(5.5f, 0.5f);

TEST(Math, matrix4x4f_constructor_values)
{
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f test(
		1.0f,
		2.0f,
		3.0f,
		4.0f,
		5.0f,
		6.0f,
		7.0f,
		8.0f,
		9.0f,
		10.0f,
		11.0f,
		12.0f,
		13.0f,
		14.0f,
		15.0f,
		16.0f
	);

	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(1.0f, test[0][0]));

TEST(Math, matrix4x4f_assignment_plus_operator)
{
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f test(
		17.0f,
		18.0f,
		19.0f,
		20.0f,
		21.0f,
		22.0f,
		23.0f,
		24.0f,
		25.0f,
		26.0f,
		27.0f,
		28.0f,
		29.0f,
		30.0f,
		31.0f,
		32.0f
	);

	test +=
		{1.0f,
	     2.0f,
	     3.0f,
	     4.0f,
	     5.0f,
	     6.0f,
	     7.0f,
	     8.0f,
	     9.0f,
	     10.0f,
	     11.0f,
	     12.0f,
	     13.0f,
	     14.0f,
	     15.0f,
	     16.0f};

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(17.0f + 1.0f, test[0][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(18.0f + 2.0f, test[0][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(19.0f + 3.0f, test[0][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(20.0f + 4.0f, test[0][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(21.0f + 5.0f, test[1][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(22.0f + 6.0f, test[1][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(23.0f + 7.0f, test[1][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(24.0f + 8.0f, test[1][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(25.0f + 9.0f, test[2][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(26.0f + 10.0f, test[2][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(27.0f + 11.0f, test[2][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(28.0f + 12.0f, test[2][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(29.0f + 13.0f, test[3][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(30.0f + 14.0f, test[3][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(31.0f + 15.0f, test[3][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(32.0f + 16.0f, test[3][3])
	);
}

// TODO: add overloads for matrix4x3 and other
TEST(Math, matrix4x4f_assignment_multiply_operator)
{
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f copy(
		17.0f,
		18.0f,
		19.0f,
		20.0f,
		21.0f,
		22.0f,
		23.0f,
		24.0f,
		25.0f,
		26.0f,
		27.0f,
		28.0f,
		29.0f,
		30.0f,
		31.0f,
		32.0f
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f copy2{
		1.0f,
		2.0f,
		3.0f,
		4.0f,
		5.0f,
		6.0f,
		7.0f,
		8.0f,
		9.0f,
		10.0f,
		11.0f,
		12.0f,
		13.0f,
		14.0f,
		15.0f,
		16.0f
	};

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f test(
		17.0f,
		18.0f,
		19.0f,
		20.0f,
		21.0f,
		22.0f,
		23.0f,
		24.0f,
		25.0f,
		26.0f,
		27.0f,
		28.0f,
		29.0f,
		30.0f,
		31.0f,
		32.0f
	);

	test *=
		{1.0f,
	     2.0f,
	     3.0f,
	     4.0f,
	     5.0f,
	     6.0f,
	     7.0f,
	     8.0f,
	     9.0f,
	     10.0f,
	     11.0f,
	     12.0f,
	     13.0f,
	     14.0f,
	     15.0f,
	     16.0f};

	kun_kotek kun_ktk
		vector<kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math base_decimal_t>
			data;

	for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
	{
		for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j)
		{
			kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math base_decimal_t value =
				0.0f;

			for (int k = 0; k < 4; ++k)
			{
				value += copy[i][k] * copy2[k][j];
			}

			data.push_back(value);
		}
	}

	kun_kotek kun_ktk size_t current_index = 0;
	for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
	{
		for (int j = 0; j < 4; ++j)
		{
			EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(
				data[current_index], test[i][j]
			));
			current_index += 1;
		}
	}
}

TEST(Math, matrix4x4f_assignment_multiply_operator_base_decimal)
{
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math base_decimal_t value = 15.0f;
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f test(
		1.0f,
		2.0f,
		3.0f,
		4.0f,
		5.0f,
		6.0f,
		7.0f,
		8.0f,
		9.0f,
		10.0f,
		11.0f,
		12.0f,
		13.0f,
		14.0f,
		15.0f,
		16.0f
	);

	test *= value;

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(1.0f * value, test[0][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(2.0f * value, test[0][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(3.0f * value, test[0][2])
	);

		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(4.0f * value, test[0][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(5.0f * value, test[1][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(6.0f * value, test[1][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(7.0f * value, test[1][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(8.0f * value, test[1][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(9.0f * value, test[2][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(10.0f * value, test[2][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(11.0f * value, test[2][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(12.0f * value, test[2][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(13.0f * value, test[3][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(14.0f * value, test[3][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(15.0f * value, test[3][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(16.0f * value, test[3][3])
	);
}

/* divide operator for matrix is undefined by default (cause it
is mathematics lol) TEST(Math,
matrix4x4f_assignment_divide_operator)
{
    kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f
copy(17.0f, 18.0f, 19.0f, 20.0f,
        21.0f, 22.0f, 23.0f, 24.0f, 25.0f, 26.0f, 27.0f, 28.0f, 29.0f,

TEST(Math, matrix4x4f_assignment_divide_operator_decimal)
{
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math base_decimal_t value = 15.0f;
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f test(
		1.0f,
		2.0f,
		3.0f,
		4.0f,
		5.0f,
		6.0f,
		7.0f,
		8.0f,
		9.0f,
		10.0f,
		11.0f,
		12.0f,
		13.0f,
		14.0f,
		15.0f,
		16.0f
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math base_decimal_t factor =
		1.f / value;

	test /= value;

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(1.0f * factor, test[0][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(2.0f * factor, test[0][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(3.0f * factor, test[0][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(4.0f * factor, test[0][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(5.0f * factor, test[1][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(6.0f * factor, test[1][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(7.0f * factor, test[1][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(8.0f * factor, test[1][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(9.0f * factor, test[2][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(10.0f * factor, test[2][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(11.0f * factor, test[2][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(12.0f * factor, test[2][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(13.0f * factor, test[3][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(14.0f * factor, test[3][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(15.0f * factor, test[3][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(16.0f * factor, test[3][3])
	);
}

TEST(Math, matrix4x4f_unary_plus_operator)
{
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f test(
		1.0f,
		2.0f,
		3.0f,
		4.0f,
		5.0f,
		6.0f,
		7.0f,
		8.0f,
		9.0f,
		10.0f,
		11.0f,
		12.0f,
		13.0f,
		14.0f,
		15.0f,
		16.0f
	);

	test = +test;

	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(1.0f, test[0][0]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(2.0f, test[0][1]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(3.0f, test[0][2]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(4.0f, test[0][3]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(5.0f, test[1][0]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(6.0f, test[1][1]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(7.0f, test[1][2]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(8.0f, test[1][3]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(9.0f, test[2][0]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(10.0f, test[2][1]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(11.0f, test[2][2]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(12.0f, test[2][3]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(13.0f, test[3][0]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(14.0f, test[3][1]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(15.0f, test[3][2]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(16.0f, test[3][3]));
}

TEST(Math, matrix4x4f_unary_minus_operator)
{
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f test(
		1.0f,
		2.0f,
		3.0f,
		4.0f,
		5.0f,
		6.0f,
		7.0f,
		8.0f,
		9.0f,
		10.0f,
		11.0f,
		12.0f,
		13.0f,
		14.0f,
		15.0f,
		16.0f
	);

	test = -test;

	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(-1.0f, test[0][0]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(-2.0f, test[0][1]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(-3.0f, test[0][2]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(-4.0f, test[0][3]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(-5.0f, test[1][0]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(-6.0f, test[1][1]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(-7.0f, test[1][2]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(-8.0f, test[1][3]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(-9.0f, test[2][0]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(-10.0f, test[2][1]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(-11.0f, test[2][2]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(-12.0f, test[2][3]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(-13.0f, test[3][0]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(-14.0f, test[3][1]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(-15.0f, test[3][2]));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(-16.0f, test[3][3]));
}

		3.0f,
		4.0f,
		5.0f,
		6.0f,
		7.0f,
		8.0f,

		10.0f,
		11.0f,
		12.0f,
		13.0f,
		14.0f,
		15.0f,
		16.0f
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f test2(
		1.0f,
		2.0f,
		3.0f,
		4.0f,
		5.0f,
		6.0f,
		7.0f,
		8.0f,

		12.0f,
		13.0f,
		14.0f,
		15.0f,
		16.0f

}

TEST(
	Math,
	matrix4x4f_operator_get_element_by_brackets_write_state
)
{
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f test(
		1.0f,
		2.0f,
		3.0f,
		4.0f,
		5.0f,
		6.0f,
		7.0f,
		8.0f,
		9.0f,
		10.0f,
		11.0f,
		12.0f,
		13.0f,
		14.0f,
		15.0f,
		16.0f
	);

	test[0][0] = test[0][0] + 1.0f;
	test[0][1] = test[0][1] + 1.0f;
	test[0][2] = test[0][2] + 1.0f;
	test[0][3] = test[0][3] + 1.0f;
	test[1][0] = test[1][0] + 1.0f;
	test[1][1] = test[1][1] + 1.0f;
	test[1][2] = test[1][2] + 1.0f;
	test[1][3] = test[1][3] + 1.0f;
	test[2][0] = test[2][0] + 1.0f;
	test[2][1] = test[2][1] + 1.0f;
	test[2][2] = test[2][2] + 1.0f;
	test[2][3] = test[2][3] + 1.0f;
	test[3][0] = test[3][0] + 1.0f;
	test[3][1] = test[3][1] + 1.0f;
	test[3][2] = test[3][2] + 1.0f;
	test[3][3] = test[3][3] + 1.0f;

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(1.0f + 1.0f, test[0][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(2.0f + 1.0f, test[0][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(3.0f + 1.0f, test[0][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(4.0f + 1.0f, test[0][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(5.0f + 1.0f, test[1][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(6.0f + 1.0f, test[1][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(7.0f + 1.0f, test[1][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(8.0f + 1.0f, test[1][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(9.0f + 1.0f, test[2][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(10.0f + 1.0f, test[2][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(11.0f + 1.0f, test[2][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(12.0f + 1.0f, test[2][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(13.0f + 1.0f, test[3][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(14.0f + 1.0f, test[3][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(15.0f + 1.0f, test[3][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(16.0f + 1.0f, test[3][3])
	);
}

TEST(Math, matrix4x4f_setters)
{
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f test(
		1.0f,
		2.0f,
		3.0f,
		4.0f,
		5.0f,
		6.0f,
		7.0f,
		8.0f,
		9.0f,
		10.0f,
		11.0f,
		12.0f,
		13.0f,
		14.0f,
		15.0f,
		16.0f
	);

	test[0][0] = (test[0][0] + 1.0f);
	test[0][1] = (test[0][1] + 1.0f);
	test[0][2] = (test[0][2] + 1.0f);
	test[0][3] = (test[0][3] + 1.0f);
	test[1][0] = (test[1][0] + 1.0f);
	test[1][1] = (test[1][1] + 1.0f);
	test[1][2] = (test[1][2] + 1.0f);
	test[1][3] = (test[1][3] + 1.0f);
	test[2][0] = (test[2][0] + 1.0f);
	test[2][1] = (test[2][1] + 1.0f);
	test[2][2] = (test[2][2] + 1.0f);
	test[2][3] = (test[2][3] + 1.0f);
	test[3][0] = (test[3][0] + 1.0f);
	test[3][1] = (test[3][1] + 1.0f);
	test[3][2] = (test[3][2] + 1.0f);
	test[3][3] = (test[3][3] + 1.0f);

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(1.0f + 1.0f, test[0][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(2.0f + 1.0f, test[0][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(3.0f + 1.0f, test[0][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(4.0f + 1.0f, test[0][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(5.0f + 1.0f, test[1][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(6.0f + 1.0f, test[1][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(7.0f + 1.0f, test[1][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(8.0f + 1.0f, test[1][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(9.0f + 1.0f, test[2][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(10.0f + 1.0f, test[2][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(11.0f + 1.0f, test[2][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(12.0f + 1.0f, test[2][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(13.0f + 1.0f, test[3][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(14.0f + 1.0f, test[3][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(15.0f + 1.0f, test[3][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(16.0f + 1.0f, test[3][3])
	);
}

TEST(Math, matrix4x4f_plus_operator)
{
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f test(
		17.0f,
		18.0f,
		19.0f,
		20.0f,
		21.0f,
		22.0f,
		23.0f,
		24.0f,
		25.0f,
		26.0f,
		27.0f,
		28.0f,
		29.0f,
		30.0f,
		31.0f,
		32.0f
	);

	test = test +
		kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f(
			   1.0f,
			   2.0f,
			   3.0f,
			   4.0f,
			   5.0f,
			   6.0f,
			   7.0f,
			   8.0f,
			   9.0f,
			   10.0f,
			   11.0f,
			   12.0f,
			   13.0f,
			   14.0f,
			   15.0f,
			   16.0f
		);

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(17.0f + 1.0f, test[0][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(18.0f + 2.0f, test[0][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(19.0f + 3.0f, test[0][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(20.0f + 4.0f, test[0][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(21.0f + 5.0f, test[1][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(22.0f + 6.0f, test[1][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(23.0f + 7.0f, test[1][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(24.0f + 8.0f, test[1][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(25.0f + 9.0f, test[2][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(26.0f + 10.0f, test[2][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(27.0f + 11.0f, test[2][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(28.0f + 12.0f, test[2][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(29.0f + 13.0f, test[3][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(30.0f + 14.0f, test[3][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(31.0f + 15.0f, test[3][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(32.0f + 16.0f, test[3][3])
	);
}

TEST(Math, matrix4x4f_minus_operator)
{
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f test(
		17.0f,
		18.0f,
		19.0f,
		20.0f,
		21.0f,
		22.0f,
		23.0f,
		24.0f,
		25.0f,
		26.0f,
		27.0f,
		28.0f,
		29.0f,
		30.0f,
		31.0f,
		32.0f
	);

	test = test -
		kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f(
			   1.0f,
			   2.0f,
			   3.0f,
			   4.0f,
			   5.0f,
			   6.0f,
			   7.0f,
			   8.0f,
			   9.0f,
			   10.0f,
			   11.0f,
			   12.0f,
			   13.0f,
			   14.0f,
			   15.0f,
			   16.0f
		);

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(17.0f - 1.0f, test[0][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(18.0f - 2.0f, test[0][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(19.0f - 3.0f, test[0][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(20.0f - 4.0f, test[0][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(21.0f - 5.0f, test[1][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(22.0f - 6.0f, test[1][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(23.0f - 7.0f, test[1][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(24.0f - 8.0f, test[1][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(25.0f - 9.0f, test[2][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(26.0f - 10.0f, test[2][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(27.0f - 11.0f, test[2][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(28.0f - 12.0f, test[2][3])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(29.0f - 13.0f, test[3][0])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(30.0f - 14.0f, test[3][1])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(31.0f - 15.0f, test[3][2])
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(32.0f - 16.0f, test[3][3])
	);
}

TEST(Math, vector1f_constructors)
{
		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec1(
		10.0f, 5.0f, 1.0f, -1.0f
	);
		#else
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec1(10.0f);
		#endif

	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec1.x(), 10.0f));

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec2(5.0f, -1.0f, 2.0f);
		#else
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec2(5.0f);
		#endif

	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec2.x(), 5.0f));

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec3(2.212f, 141.1f);
		#else
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec3(2.212f);
		#endif

	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec3.x(), 2.212f));

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec4(1241.1414f);

	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec4.x(), 1241.1414f)
	);

	float arr4[4] = {11.1f, 1.310f, 3113.0f, -13.0f};
	float arr3[3] = {1.310f, 11.1f, 3113.0f};
	float arr2[2] = {3113.0f, 1.310f};
	float arr1[1] = {
		-13.0f,
	};

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec5(arr4);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec5.x(), 11.1f));

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec6(arr3);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec6.x(), 1.310f));

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec7(arr2);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec7.x(), 3113.0f));

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec8(arr1);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec8.x(), -13.0f));

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec9(&arr1[0]);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec9.x(), -13.0f));

	float* p_val = nullptr;
	float val = 3.11f;
	p_val = &val;

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec10(p_val);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec10.x(), 3.11f));

	const float carr4[4] = {11.1f, 1.310f, 3113.0f, -13.0f};
	const float carr3[3] = {1.310f, 11.1f, 3113.0f};
	const float carr2[2] = {3113.0f, 1.310f};
	const float carr1[1] = {
		-13.0f,
	};

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec11(carr4);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec11.x(), 11.1f));

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec12(carr3);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec12.x(), 1.310f));

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec13(carr2);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec13.x(), 3113.0f));

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec14(carr1);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec14.x(), -13.0f));
}

TEST(Math, vector2f_contsructors)
{
		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec1(
		10.0f, 5.0f, 1.0f, -1.0f
	);
		#else
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec1(10.0f, 5.0f);
		#endif

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec1.x(), 10.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec1.y(), 5.0f)
	);

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec2(5.0f, -1.0f, 2.0f);
		#else
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec2(5.0f, -1.0f);
		#endif

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec2.x(), 5.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec2.y(), -1.0f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec3(2.212f, 141.1f);

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec3.x(), 2.212f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec3.y(), 141.1f)
	);

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec4(1241.1414f);
		#else
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec4(1241.1414f, 0.0f);
		#endif

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec4.x(), 1241.1414f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec4.y(), 0.0f)
	);

	float arr4[4] = {11.1f, 1.310f, 3113.0f, -13.0f};
	float arr3[3] = {1.310f, 11.1f, 3113.0f};
	float arr2[2] = {3113.0f, 1.310f};
	float arr1[1] = {-13.0f};

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec5(arr4);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec5.x(), 11.1f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec5.y(), 1.310f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec6(arr3);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec6.x(), 1.310f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec6.y(), 11.1f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec7(arr2);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec7.x(), 3113.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec7.y(), 1.310f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec8(arr1);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec8.x(), -13.0f));

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec9(&arr1[0]);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec9.x(), -13.0f));

	float* p_val = nullptr;
	float val = 3.11f;
	p_val = &val;

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec10(p_val);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec10.x(), 3.11f));

	const float carr4[4] = {11.1f, 1.310f, 3113.0f, -13.0f};
	const float carr3[3] = {1.310f, 11.1f, 3113.0f};

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	const float carr2[2] = {3113.0f, 1.310f};
	const float carr1[1] = {
		-13.0f,
	};
		#else
	const float carr2[3] = {3113.0f, 1.310f, 0.0f};
	const float carr1[3] = {-13.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
		#endif

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec11(carr4);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec11.x(), 11.1f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec11.y(), 1.310f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec12(carr3);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec12.x(), 1.310f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec12.y(), 11.1f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec13(carr2);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec13.x(), 3113.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec13.y(), 1.310f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec14(carr1);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec14.x(), -13.0f));
}

TEST(Math, vector3f_constructors)
{
		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING

		10.0f, 5.0f, 1.0f, -1.0f
	);
		#else

		#endif

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec1.x(), 10.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec1.y(), 5.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec1.z(), 1.0f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec2(5.0f, -1.0f, 2.0f);

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec2.x(), 5.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec2.y(), -1.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec2.z(), 2.0f)
	);

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec3(2.212f, 141.1f);
		#else
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec3(
		2.212f, 141.1f, 0.0f
	);
		#endif

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec3.x(), 2.212f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec3.y(), 141.1f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec3.z(), 0.0f)
	);

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec4(1241.1414f);
		#else
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec4(
		1241.1414f, 0.0f, 0.0f
	);
		#endif

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec4.x(), 1241.1414f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec4.y(), 0.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec4.z(), 0.0f)
	);

	float arr4[4] = {11.1f, 1.310f, 3113.0f, -13.0f};
	float arr3[3] = {1.310f, 11.1f, 3113.0f};

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	float arr2[2] = {3113.0f, 1.310f};
	float arr1[1] = {
		-13.0f,
	};
		#else
	float arr2[3] = {3113.0f, 1.310f, 0.0f};
	float arr1[3] = {-13.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
		#endif

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec5(arr4);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec5.x(), 11.1f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec5.y(), 1.310f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec5.z(), 3113.0f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec6(arr3);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec6.x(), 1.310f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec6.y(), 11.1f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec6.z(), 3113.0f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec7(arr2);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec7.x(), 3113.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec7.y(), 1.310f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec8(arr1);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec8.x(), -13.0f));

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec9(&arr1[0]);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec9.x(), -13.0f));

	float* p_val = nullptr;
	float val = 3.11f;
	p_val = &val;

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec10(p_val);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec10.x(), 3.11f));

	const float carr4[4] = {11.1f, 1.310f, 3113.0f, -13.0f};
	const float carr3[3] = {1.310f, 11.1f, 3113.0f};
	const float carr2[2] = {3113.0f, 1.310f};
	const float carr1[1] = {
		-13.0f,
	};

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec11(carr4);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec11.x(), 11.1f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec11.y(), 1.310f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec11.z(), 3113.0f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec12(carr3);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec12.x(), 1.310f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec12.y(), 11.1f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec12.z(), 3113.0f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec13(carr2);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec13.x(), 3113.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec13.y(), 1.310f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec14(carr1);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec14.x(), -13.0f));
}

TEST(Math, vector4f_constructors)
{
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec1(
		10.0f, 5.0f, 1.0f, -1.0f
	);

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec1.x(), 10.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec1.y(), 5.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec1.z(), 1.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec1.w(), -1.0f)
	);

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec2(5.0f, -1.0f, 2.0f);
		#else
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec2(
		5.0f, -1.0f, 2.0f, 0.0f
	);
		#endif

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec2.x(), 5.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec2.y(), -1.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec2.z(), 2.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec2.w(), 0.0f)
	);

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec3(2.212f, 141.1f);
		#else
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec3(
		2.212f, 141.1f, 0.0f, 0.0f
	);
		#endif

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec3.x(), 2.212f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec3.y(), 141.1f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec3.z(), 0.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec3.w(), 0.0f)
	);

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec4(1241.1414f);
		#else
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec4(
		1241.1414f, 0.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f
	);
		#endif

	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec4.x(), 1241.1414f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec4.y(), 0.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec4.z(), 0.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec4.w(), 0.0f)
	);

	float arr4[4] = {11.1f, 1.310f, 3113.0f, -13.0f};
	float arr3[3] = {1.310f, 11.1f, 3113.0f};

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	float arr2[2] = {3113.0f, 1.310f};
	float arr1[1] = {
		-13.0f,
	};
		#else
	float arr2[3] = {3113.0f, 1.310f, 0.0f};
	float arr1[3] = {-13.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
		#endif

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec5(arr4);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec5.x(), 11.1f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec5.y(), 1.310f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec5.z(), 3113.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec5.w(), -13.0f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec6(arr3);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec6.x(), 1.310f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec6.y(), 11.1f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec6.z(), 3113.0f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec7(arr2);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec7.x(), 3113.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec7.y(), 1.310f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec8(arr1);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec8.x(), -13.0f));

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec9(&arr1[0]);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec9.x(), -13.0f));

	float* p_val = nullptr;
	float val = 3.11f;
	p_val = &val;

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec10(p_val);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec10.x(), 3.11f));

	const float carr4[4] = {11.1f, 1.310f, 3113.0f, -13.0f};
	const float carr3[3] = {1.310f, 11.1f, 3113.0f};

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	const float carr2[2] = {3113.0f, 1.310f};
	const float carr1[1] = {
		-13.0f,
	};
		#else
	const float carr2[3] = {3113.0f, 1.310f, 0.0f};
	const float carr1[3] = {-13.0f, 0.0f, 0.0f};
		#endif

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec11(carr4);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec11.x(), 11.1f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec11.y(), 1.310f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec11.z(), 3113.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec11.w(), -13.0f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec12(carr3);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec12.x(), 1.310f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec12.y(), 11.1f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec12.z(), 3113.0f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec13(carr2);
	EXPECT_TRUE(
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec13.x(), 3113.0f) &&
		kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec13.y(), 1.310f)
	);

	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector4f vec14(carr1);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(vec14.x(), -13.0f));
}

TEST(Math, matrixnf_view_t_constructors)
{
	float p_values[] = {10.0f, 20.0f, 30.0f, 40.0f};
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrixnf_view_t view(
		p_values, 2, 2
	);

	EXPECT_TRUE(view.data() != nullptr);
	EXPECT_TRUE(view.size_of() == sizeof(p_values));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(view[0][0], 10.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(view[0][1], 20.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(view[1][0], 30.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(view[1][1], 40.0f));

	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(
		view[0][0], get_math_component_x(view[0])
	));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(
		view[0][1], get_math_component_y(view[0])
	));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(
		view[1][0], get_math_component_x(view[1])
	));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(
		view[1][1], get_math_component_y(view[1])
	));
}

TEST(Math, matrixnf_view_t_arithmetic_operators)
{
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f vec4(
		1.0f,
		2.0f,
		3.0f,
		4.0f,
		5.0f,
		6.0f,
		7.0f,
		8.0f,
		9.0f,
		10.0f,
		11.0f,
		12.0f,
		13.0f,
		14.0f,
		15.0f,
		16.0f
	);

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec3(3.0f, 7.0f, 9.0f);
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec2(2.0f, 5.0f);
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec1(10.0f);
		#endif

	float p_values[] = {
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f
	};
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrixnf_view_t view(
		p_values, 4, 4
	);

	auto res4 = view + vec4;

	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(0, 0), 11.0f)
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(0, 1), 12.0f)
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(0, 2), 13.0f)
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(0, 3), 14.0f)
	);
	// row 1
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(1, 0), 15.0f)
	); // 10+5
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(1, 1), 16.0f)
	); // 10+6
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(1, 2), 17.0f)
	); // 10+7
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(1, 3), 18.0f)
	); // 10+8

	// row 2
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(2, 0), 19.0f)
	); // 10+9
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(2, 1), 20.0f)
	); // 10+10
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(2, 2), 21.0f)
	); // 10+11
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(2, 3), 22.0f)
	); // 10+12

	// row 3
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(3, 0), 23.0f)
	); // 10+13
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(3, 1), 24.0f)
	); // 10+14
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(3, 2), 25.0f)
	); // 10+15
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(3, 3), 26.0f)
	); // 10+16

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	auto res3 = view + vec3;
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res3.x(), 13.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res3.y(), 17.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res3.z(), 19.0f));

	auto res2 = view + vec2;
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res2.x(), 12.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res2.y(), 15.0f));

	auto res1 = view + vec1;
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res1.x(), 20.0f));
		#endif

	res4 = vec4 + view;
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4[0][0], 11.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4[0][1], 12.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4[0][2], 13.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4[0][3], 14.0f));
	// row 1
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4[1][0], 15.0f)
	); // 10+5
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4[1][1], 16.0f)
	); // 10+6
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4[1][2], 17.0f)
	); // 10+7
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4[1][3], 18.0f)
	); // 10+8

	// row 2
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4[2][0], 19.0f)
	); // 10+9
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4[2][1], 20.0f)
	); // 10+10
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4[2][2], 21.0f)
	); // 10+11
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4[2][3], 22.0f)
	); // 10+12

	// row 3
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4[3][0], 23.0f)
	); // 10+13
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4[3][1], 24.0f)
	); // 10+14
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4[3][2], 25.0f)
	); // 10+15
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4[3][3], 26.0f)
	); // 10+16

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	res3 = vec3 + view;
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res3.x(), 13.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res3.y(), 17.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res3.z(), 19.0f));

	res2 = vec2 + view;
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res2.x(), 12.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res2.y(), 15.0f));

	res1 = vec1 + view;
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res1.x(), 20.0f));
		#endif
}

TEST(Math, matrixnf_view_t_minus_operators)
{
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrix4x4f mat4(
		1.0f,
		2.0f,
		3.0f,
		4.0f,
		5.0f,
		6.0f,
		7.0f,
		8.0f,
		9.0f,
		10.0f,
		11.0f,
		12.0f,
		13.0f,
		14.0f,
		15.0f,
		16.0f
	);

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector3f vec3(3.0f, 7.0f, 9.0f);
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector2f vec2(2.0f, 5.0f);
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math vector1f vec1(10.0f);
		#endif

	float p_values[] = {
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f,
		10.0f
	};
	kun_kotek kun_ktk kun_math matrixnf_view_t view(
		p_values, 4, 4
	);

	auto res4 = view - mat4;
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(0, 0), 9.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(0, 1), 8.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(0, 2), 7.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(0, 3), 6.0f));

	// row 1
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(1, 0), 5.0f)
	); // 10-5
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(1, 1), 4.0f)
	); // 10-6
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(1, 2), 3.0f)
	); // 10-7
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(1, 3), 2.0f)
	); // 10-8

	// row 2
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(2, 0), 1.0f)
	); // 10-9
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(2, 1), 0.0f)
	); // 10-10
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(2, 2), -1.0f)
	); // 10-11
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(2, 3), -2.0f)
	); // 10-12

	// row 3
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(3, 0), -3.0f)
	); // 10-13
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(3, 1), -4.0f)
	); // 10-14
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(3, 2), -5.0f)
	); // 10-15
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(3, 3), -6.0f)
	); // 10-16

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	auto res3 = view - vec3;
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res3.x(), 7.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res3.y(), 3.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res3.z(), 1.0f));

	auto res2 = view - vec2;
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res2.x(), 8.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res2.y(), 5.0f));

	auto res1 = view - vec1;
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res1.x(), 0.0f));
		#endif

	res4 = mat4 - view;
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(0, 0), -9.0f)
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(0, 1), -8.0f)
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(0, 2), -7.0f)
	);
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(0, 3), -6.0f)
	);

	// row 1
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(1, 0), -5.0f)
	); // 5-10
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(1, 1), -4.0f)
	); // 6-10
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(1, 2), -3.0f)
	); // 7-10
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(1, 3), -2.0f)
	); // 8-10

	// row 2
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(2, 0), -1.0f)
	); // 9-10
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(2, 1), 0.0f)
	); // 10-10
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(2, 2), 1.0f)
	); // 11-10
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(2, 3), 2.0f)
	); // 12-10

	// row 3
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(3, 0), 3.0f)
	); // 13-10
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(3, 1), 4.0f)
	); // 14-10
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(3, 2), 5.0f)
	); // 15-10
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res4.e(3, 3), 6.0f)
	); // 16-10

		#ifdef KOTEK_USE_MATH_LIBRARY_IMPLICIT_CASTING
	res3 = vec3 - view;
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res3.x(), -7.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res3.y(), -3.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res3.z(), -1.0f));

	res2 = vec2 - view;
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res2.x(), -8.0f));
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res2.y(), -5.0f));

	res1 = vec1 - view;
	EXPECT_TRUE(kun_kotek kun_ktk is_equal(res1.x(), 0.0f));
		#endif
}
```

`src/kotek.core.memory.cpu/include/offsetAllocator.hpp`:

```hpp
// (C) Sebastian Aaltonen 2023
// MIT License (see file: LICENSE)

//#define USE_16_BIT_OFFSETS

namespace OffsetAllocator
{
    typedef unsigned char uint8;
    typedef unsigned int uint16;
    typedef unsigned int uint32;

    // 16 bit offsets mode will halve the metadata storage cost
    // But it only supports up to 65536 maximum allocation count
#ifdef USE_16_BIT_NODE_INDICES
    typedef uint16 NodeIndex;
#else
    typedef uint32 NodeIndex;
#endif

    static constexpr uint32 NUM_TOP_BINS = 32;
    static constexpr uint32 BINS_PER_LEAF = 8;
    static constexpr uint32 TOP_BINS_INDEX_SHIFT = 3;
    static constexpr uint32 LEAF_BINS_INDEX_MASK = 0x7;
    static constexpr uint32 NUM_LEAF_BINS = NUM_TOP_BINS * BINS_PER_LEAF;

    struct Allocation
    {
        static constexpr uint32 NO_SPACE = 0xffffffff;
        
        uint32 offset = NO_SPACE;
        NodeIndex metadata = NO_SPACE; // internal: node index
    };

    struct StorageReport
    {
        uint32 totalFreeSpace;
        uint32 largestFreeRegion;
    };

    struct StorageReportFull
    {
        struct Region
        {
            uint32 size;
            uint32 count;
        };
        
        Region freeRegions[NUM_LEAF_BINS];
    };

    class Allocator
    {
    public:
        Allocator(uint32 size, uint32 maxAllocs = 128 * 1024);
        Allocator(Allocator &&other);
        ~Allocator();
        void reset();
        
        Allocation allocate(uint32 size);
        void deallocate(Allocation allocation);

        uint32 allocationSize(Allocation allocation) const;
        StorageReport storageReport() const;
        StorageReportFull storageReportFull() const;
        
    private:
        uint32 insertNodeIntoBin(uint32 size, uint32 dataOffset);
        void removeNodeFromBin(uint32 nodeIndex);

        struct Node
        {
            static constexpr NodeIndex unused = 0xffffffff;
            
            uint32 dataOffset = 0;
            uint32 dataSize = 0;
            NodeIndex binListPrev = unused;
            NodeIndex binListNext = unused;
            NodeIndex neighborPrev = unused;
            NodeIndex neighborNext = unused;
            bool used = false; // TODO: Merge as bit flag
        };
    
        uint32 m_size;
        uint32 m_maxAllocs;
        uint32 m_freeStorage;

        uint32 m_usedBinsTop;
        uint8 m_usedBins[NUM_TOP_BINS];
        NodeIndex m_binIndices[NUM_LEAF_BINS];
                
        Node* m_nodes;
        NodeIndex* m_freeNodes;
        uint32 m_freeOffset;
    };
}
```
